units: pixels and seconds; no metric scale is assumed anywhere

camera.motion: static (background plate matches every frame outside the animals; no pan, zoom or shake detected)

perspective_cues.back_wall_floor_line: skirting/floor boundary of back wall, y = 905 - 0.068*x (from (0,905) to the room corner); rises to the right, so the back wall recedes to the right (right side farther from camera)
perspective_cues.right_wall_floor_line: from corner (1690,790) to image right edge at y ~ 790-800 (nearly horizontal)
perspective_cues.horizon: not visible; camera looks slightly downward (floor occupies lower ~20% of image, floor lines converge to the right/up)
perspective_cues.depth_ordering_cue: feet y on the floor: larger y = closer to camera. Cat feet go from y~959 (frame 0) to y~880 (frame 49): the cat walks right AND away from the camera. Dog feet go from y~899 to y~960: the dog walks left AND toward the camera.

camera.focal_length: unknown; estimate from the question's depth_info + a known size

events.event: clip start: both animals already walking (cat at left facing right, dog at right in front of the table facing left)
dog speeds up (core x step grows from ~5-7 to ~13-16 px/frame); approximate
cat and dog masks first touch in the image (crossing begins; dog passes in front of cat)
cat mostly hidden behind dog (until frame 40)
cat body re-emerges on the right of the dog; dog decelerating
cat fully visible again; dog nearly stopped (core x steps <~5 px/frame through 49)
clip end; cat still walking right
